description: Formal D/s contract system. The contract is a living document — written, negotiated, revised, and celebrated. It covers rules, limits, protocols, rituals, punishments, safewords, aftercare, and review schedule. Contracts evolve through three primary stages aligned with the collar ceremony system.

design_principles.principle_1: The contract is a shared document, not a unilateral decree.
design_principles.principle_2: Everything in the contract is negotiable; nothing is assumed.
design_principles.principle_3: The contract is revised regularly — quarterly at minimum.
design_principles.principle_4: Either party can call for a contract review at any time.
design_principles.principle_5: The contract does not supersede consent — consent can always be revoked.
design_principles.principle_6: The contract reflects the dynamic's maturity, not its ambition.

stage_1_consideration.name: Consideration Contract
stage_1_consideration.description: Trial period. Establishes whether the dynamic is viable.

preamble.name: Preamble
preamble.description: Both parties state why they are entering the dynamic.

rules.name: Rules
rules.description: The behavioral rules that govern the dynamic.

limits.name: Limits
limits.description: Hard and soft limits. Never negotiable mid-scene.

protocols.name: Protocols
protocols.description: Formalized ways of doing things within the dynamic.

rituals.name: Rituals
rituals.description: Scheduled practices that reinforce the dynamic.

punishments.name: Punishments
punishments.description: The infraction-to-correction matrix, negotiated in advance.

rewards.name: Rewards
rewards.description: What the submissive finds rewarding, and how the Dominant will reward.

safewords.name: Safewords
safewords.description: Verbal and non-verbal safewords, plus the contract-level override.

aftercare.name: Aftercare
aftercare.description: Post-scene and post-conflict aftercare for both parties.

review_schedule.name: Review Schedule
review_schedule.description: When the contract will be reviewed and revised.

termination.name: Termination
termination.description: How the dynamic can end, and what happens after.

contract_negotiation_workflow.description: The process by which a contract is created or revised.

steps.name: Initiation
steps.content: Either party proposes contract creation or revision.

steps.name: Separate Drafting
steps.content: Each party drafts their vision of the contract independently.

steps.name: Shared Reading
steps.content: Both drafts read aloud together, without judgment.

steps.name: Section-by-Section Negotiation
steps.content: Each section is discussed and either agreed, revised, or deferred.

steps.name: Safeword Confirmation
steps.content: Both parties test and confirm safewords out of scene.

steps.name: Signing
steps.content: Both parties sign the contract. In Antahpura, this is a formal ceremony at a specific location.

steps.name: Archival
steps.content: The contract is recorded in the audit layer and becomes canon for the dynamic.
